title: PEAT: Pseudo-Error Assessment for GPU Kernel Validation in DNN Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.13544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely adopted in various fields, driving an emerging trend in developing software stacks associated with DNN training systems. For example, many codes have been ported across different frameworks or developed to leverage the computing power of GPUs or domain-specific accelerators. However, validating a kernel implementation in DNN training is time-consuming and generally requires massive storage. Specifically, this poses a fundamental question: how to characterize the behavior of a new implementation when it is integrated into a DNN training flow. Unfortunately, this problem is not well investigated in the literature, to the best of our knowledge. translated_title: PEAT：面向深度神经网络训练中GPU内核验证的伪错误评估
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNN）已被广泛应用于各个领域，这推动了与DNN训练系统相关软件栈开发的新趋势。例如，许多代码被移植到不同的框架中，或被开发出来以利用GPU或领域专用加速器的计算能力。然而，验证DNN训练中的内核实现非常耗时，且通常需要大量的存储空间。具体而言，这提出了一个根本性的问题：如何刻画一个新实现被集成到DNN训练流程中时的行为。据我们所知，这个问题在现有文献中尚未得到充分研究。为了解决这一不足，我们提出了PEAT——一个用于DNN训练中GPU内核验证相关伪错误评估的轻量级检查框架。首先，受传统故障注入方法的启发……
tldr: 本文提出了PEAT框架，通过伪错误评估技术为DNN训练中的GPU内核实现提供轻量级的验证方案，解决了传统验证方法耗时且存储开销大的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PEAT, a lightweight pseudo-error assessment framework that enables efficient GPU kernel validation in DNN training, addressing the time-consuming and storage-intensive nature of traditional validation methods.
